notes:
## Bug fixes

- **The volume control now moves with a scheduled fade, on every theme.** It travels down over the last seconds of a slot and back up when the next station is playing, with the number beside it counting along.
- It only ever worked on the two themes that draw the fader as a knob. Every other theme places its slider thumb by value, which the fade never touched — so on most themes nothing moved at all.
- The stored setting is still never written by a fade, and a finger on the fader still wins while it is there.
